new_data_information: D is a deterministic function of existing public G plus a sampled anchor panel S. It adds no external edge/label measurement or information conditional on (G,X,S). It exposes a globally computed feature to the restricted predictor; do not claim new dataset information.

unaugmented_channel_factor_scope.applies_to: Current per-member FactorLinear input/output channel vectors shared across nodes, not free node-indexed scalar parameters. Native per-node LayerNorm and local depth2 SAGE at dropout-off serving.
unaugmented_channel_factor_scope.factor_map: For row x, y_m=((x⊙r_m)W^T)⊙s_m+b. r_m has feature dimension, s_m hidden dimension; neither is a node-position lookup.
unaugmented_channel_factor_scope.restricted_locality: For any fixed learned parameters, feature-preserving rooted2-hop neighborhood isomorphism (respecting actual directed/multiedge support and native operator) yields equal deterministic native outputs in exact arithmetic. Induction: same node-wise transform; equal neighbor multiset yields same mean; same per-node residual/FFN/LayerNorm; repeat2 blocks. Different globally shared learned parameters cannot break the equality within a route. FP32 order artefacts are not a useful structural-information guarantee.
unaugmented_channel_factor_scope.anchor_escape_condition: If D restricted to these rooted neighborhoods differs in a way not removed by the new learner, the equality premise fails. This demonstrates an available distinguishing feature, not actual learnability/accuracy or a WikiCS missing-information diagnosis.
unaugmented_channel_factor_scope.symbolic_witness: Disjoint C6 andC8 cycles, every node has the same original feature. Every node in either cycle receives identical native mean-SAGE representations for any node-shared channel factors in exact arithmetic. A nonempty anchor set confined toC6 produces finite positive distance fields there and0 onC8. The new attributes differ. This is a symbolic witness, not a run, representative graph, draw-probability guarantee or cost estimate.
unaugmented_channel_factor_scope.redundancy_limit: Actual WikiCS features can already distinguish nodes or correlate with location. If D=XB on the finite graph, an ordinary single linear stem can absorb DW_D into X(W_X+BW_D). Nonlinear recoverability can also make fields redundant. Such redundancy can still change a restricted BE parameterization/training bias, but is not new graph information. No rank/projection or symmetry diagnostic was run.

augmented_mask_absorption.consequence: The all128-anchor ordinary shared factorized model contains the fixed32-assigned model function family at the identical428-column stem shape. Hard assignment adds no expressive power once D is supplied. For a single or independent body, zeroing nonassigned stem columns likewise embeds the assigned function in the all-anchor model.
augmented_mask_absorption.training_difference: Fixed masks correspond to permanently constrained zero metadata input-factor entries. Merely initializing such free entries at0 does not keep them0. The common control can learn or relinquish masking; its gradients, exposure and optimization differ. Therefore this is a useful-training-constraint hypothesis, not an expressivity separation or optimizer equivalence claim.
augmented_mask_absorption.functional_private_credit: Each selected metadata column is active in one route only, so its shared slow stem column receives functionally private input credit. This is disclosed partial ownership, with original-feature stem and downstream propagation still shared.
augmented_mask_absorption.comparison_limit: Beating commonall-anchor under a fixed recipe supports a useful restricted inductive bias/optimization procedure. It cannot prove greater information, distinct architectures, measured shared interference or reduced variance.

equivariance_and_generalization.joint_graph_and_anchors: If nodes, public features, edges and the stored anchor identities are jointly permuted, distance fields transform equivariantly. This is a marked-graph statement.
equivariance_and_generalization.fixed_seed_node_order: Recomputing anchors after relabeling with the same RNGseed need not map the stored panel to its permuted counterpart. Fixed anchor-coordinate semantics can encode transductive identity; no deterministic unmarked-graph invariance or inductive theorem is claimed.
equivariance_and_generalization.RP_overlap: RP identifier augmentation already breaks WL symmetries, then restores graph invariance by all-permutation averaging or controlled approximations. Four learned persistent panels do not inherit that argument.
equivariance_and_generalization.DE_overlap: DE explicitly appends structural distances to node attributes. Its targetsetS/query-conditioned representation and proper-GNN theorems differ from our fixed global panels and noninjective mean-SAGE; no stronger-WL theorem imported.

rival_margin: For a BASE strict rival c_i, candidate probabilitymean can rank y_i over c_i only if (1/4)sum_m[p_m(y_i)-p_m(c_i)]>0; final correctness additionally needs positive pooled margin against every other class. At least one candidate route must reverse the pairwise y/c ordering, but need not be individually argmax-correct; aggregation-only correctness must be reported separately.
